seoDescription: Enter an amount and Felváltom! tells you exactly how many banknotes and coins you need. A free cash-breakdown calculator for HUF, EUR and USD.
heroSubtitle: Enter the amount, and we’ll tell you how many banknotes and coins you need! Felvaltom! is a quick and practical solution for handling cash — or just for curiosity.
inputTooltip: Enter the amount you want to denominate
denominateHelper: Press Enter or click Denominate to calculate
denominateHelperInvalid: Enter a valid amount to continue
enterToSee: Enter an amount and currency to see the breakdown.

whatAreCookies.title: What are cookies?
whatAreCookies.content: Cookies are small text files stored on the user's device by the website to save browsing information.

whatCookiesWeUse.title: What cookies do we use?

whatCookiesWeUse.analyticsCookie: Analytical cookies (Google Analytics) – These help us understand how visitors use the website (e.g., number of page views, time spent).

managingCookies.title: How can you manage cookies?
managingCookies.content: Most browsers allow you to disable or delete cookies. Please note that disabling cookies may affect the functionality of the website.

collectedData.title: Data Collected

collectedData.localData: Data stored locally on the user's device: the history of recent calculations (amount, currency, timestamp). This is stored only in the browser (localStorage), is never sent to or stored on the operator's server, and can be deleted at any time using the "Clear History" button or by clearing browser data.

dataForwarding.content: Google acts as a data processor. Data may be stored on servers outside the EU. Google complies with GDPR regulations.

dataRetention.content: Statistical data is retained for the default duration set by Google Analytics (e.g., 14 months). The data controller does not collect personally identifiable information.
